component.name: Dash Desktop Crypto Wallet
component.summary: Dash crypto wallet with Platform and shielded transactions

description.p: A desktop wallet for Dash, supporting both Dash Core (Layer 1) and Dash Platform / Evolution (Layer 2).

ul.li: Create or import HD wallets from a BIP39 seed phrase, password-encrypted at rest
L1 balance, transaction history, address book and receive with QR code
Dash Platform identities, DPNS names and credit balances
Shielded transactions: shield credits into the Orchard pool, send privately between shielded addresses, and unshield or withdraw back out
Mainnet and testnet, via Dashscan API or direct P2P (SPV) sync
